$comment: Single source of truth. Tailwind reads this for web; React Native reads it for mobile. Never hardcode a value that lives here. Derived from design-reference/maison2.html and product.html.
$direction: maison — noir base, brass accent, bone text

color.$dangerNote: Errors and refusals. Its own token because the form-error colour was the HEART note-tier colour reused in seven files — a palette entry doing a job it was never chosen for, so changing the pyramid would have changed every error message.

$colorLightNote: The LIGHT theme's primitives. A separate object rather than a second value beside each dark one, because the two palettes are not the same colours at different lightnesses — the accent has to darken to #80612E to stay readable on paper, and the greys change hue as well as value. Roles are assembled from both objects in theme.ts; no component ever names a primitive.

$contrastNotesLight.rule: On paper the floor is approached from ABOVE: anything LIGHTER than #6B635A fails 4.5:1. #767068 is already 4.23:1.

$contrastNotes.faint-on-noir: 5.67:1 — smallest labels; 4.58:1 on l3, which is the binding one
$contrastNotes.rule: The floor is set by the LIGHTEST surface a label may be printed on, not by the page. faint was #8B837A — 5.3:1 on noir and 4.28:1 on an l3 panel — so it passed every assertion and would have failed the moment anything used the third depth step. Never introduce a grey darker than #90887F.

$noteTierNote: The pyramid tiers, per theme. `base` was #95764A, which cleared 4.5:1 on the page ground and quietly failed it at 4.43:1 on an l1 panel — the surface the pyramid is actually printed on. The assertion checked one ground and the component used the other. The values here clear the floor on EVERY surface role, including the l2 and l3 steps nothing paints on yet: a role that only works on some of the surfaces it is allowed on is a trap left for whoever uses the next one.
$stageNote: The lit stage behind a bottle: a warm glow on the plate, falling to near-black. A literal palette like scentFamily, dark in BOTH themes, because a perfume is photographed in a dark room whichever way the page is lit. Consolidated 21 Sep 2026 (DR-13) from four hand-tuned copies across the home hero, product page, product tile and cart tile that differed by at most 3/255 per channel; values taken from the product tile. Each screen keeps its own gradient shape and stops; only the colours are shared.

font.$usage: Amiri for Arabic headings only. Bodoni Moda for Latin small-caps labels only (always letterspaced). IBM Plex Sans Arabic for everything else. On the English site (D-3, 30 Sep 2026): Bodoni Moda for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body text — the Latin companion of the Arabic body face, so the two sites read as one family.

fontSize.$desktopNote: The ramp above is the PHONE ramp. From 1024px the Lg steps take over: a 33px headline on a 27-inch monitor reads as a phone screenshot, not as a maison.
fontSize.$minimumNote: HIG mobile minimum is 11pt. The 9.5 and 10.5 values are permitted ONLY for letterspaced Bodoni labels and numeric captions, never for reading text.

lineHeight.$comment: Arabic needs more leading than Latin. Set for Arabic first.

motion.$comment: Luxury motion has weight. Things settle; they never pop, bounce or spring.
motion.$rule: Nothing under 120ms — below that a transition reads as a glitch, not a move.

easing.$forbidden: No spring. No overshoot. No ease-in-back. A bouncing element reads as a consumer app instantly.

haptic.$comment: Mobile only. Subtle, meaningful, rare. Haptics on every tap is noise.

elevation.$rule: There is deliberately no shadow scale. Depth comes from value (l1 → l2 → l3) and hairlines. A drop shadow requires written justification.

size.$rule: 44pt is the hard minimum for anything tappable. A control may LOOK smaller (e.g. a 36px circle) but its hit area must be 44pt.
